pattern.short_summary: Alongside the generative route, the interface keeps a route by which the user authors the same material directly: a free-text field, editable nodes, a custom operation, a user-added prompt.
pattern.definition: Alongside the generative route, the interface keeps a route by which the user authors the same material directly: a free-text field, editable nodes, a custom operation, a user-added prompt. Neither route is a fallback mode; both are available at the same time.
pattern.structural_signature: Two input routes converge on the same artifact slot — one generated, one hand-authored — with no mode switch between them, and the artifact can record contributions from both. Removing the generator leaves the interface still operable for that slot; the slot's schema is identical whichever route filled it.

dimension.category_description: How users inspect, modify, scope, revise, accept, program, or interrupt generated work at the artifact level.
dimension.classification_boundary: Centers user control during or after generation, including editable intermediate generators and representations.
